card: This PR implements block serving and fetching for BIP 332 (Stale Tip Relay), adding a -staletips=blocks mode. Header-only stale tip relay leaves nodes unable to inspect the actual block data of reorged forks, while routing stale blocks through standard block sync risks disconnecting peers if ancestors are unavailable or invalid. Stale branch blocks are fetched backwards from the tip using a separate, best-effort download scheduler with customized peer misbehavior rules. This work depends on PR 36920 and completes the protocol mechanisms tracked under issue 36833.
evidence: PR description: 'This PR lets peers fetch the blocks behind the stale tips announced in #36920. We now serve blocks on the stale branches we track, and the new -staletips=blocks mode downloads the branches peers offer.'

PR description: 'This also fixes how #36920 handles a higher-work staletip. It used to go through normal block download, which expected every ancestor from that peer and could disconnect it. Now it's fetched best-effort, in both modes.'
problem: Header-only stale tip relay allows nodes to observe chain reorganizations and stale branches, but does not allow retrieving the underlying transactions or block contents. Reusing normal block download for stale branches can cause unwarranted peer disconnections, because peers only guarantee having the tip and may relay blocks whose transactions were never connected or validated.

risk.why: Flaws in best-effort block fetching, DoS rate limiting, or exemption from invalid-block penalties could expose nodes to resource exhaustion or network-level denial-of-service.

scope_notes: This PR is stacked on PR #36920 (and #36919). The first 21 commits belong to those prerequisite PRs; the distinct changes for this PR begin at commit b6a5c40021 ('refactor: extract block serving limit checks').
summary: Implements the block serving and downloading components of BIP 332 (Stale Tip Relay), building on stale-tip header relay. It introduces the `-staletips=blocks` configuration mode to fetch blocks for stale branches offered by peers and serves tracked stale-branch blocks upon request. Stale-branch block downloads run on an independent best-effort schedule separate from active-chain block download to prevent peer disconnections when ancestors are missing or unvalidated.
